text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Here we are at the Mile Championship! 1,600 meters on turf! And I know who my toughest opponent will be!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: She's always energetic and the life of the party! A sprinter with explosive breakaway speed…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh man, my heart is racing! Let's have a good race today!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Chills, girl! You're so chill, imma call you Chill-hauser!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: No cap though, I'm low-key shook. But sittin' around shakin' in my cleats won't get me that dub!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: So catch me hitting that rainbow front running breakaway win so I can go home and wahey with my besties!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Y'know, like, let's have a good race!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh! Then, wahey to you too!
